svg.aria-label: The six loading steps NiftyStats runs once per browser before the first analysis, in order, with the words the page shows at each one.
svg.title: The one-time wait
svg.desc: Six steps in src/lib/pyodide/client.ts: downloading the Python engine, then numpy, pandas, scipy and scikit-learn from the jsDelivr CDN, then compiling the four bundled analysis modules. After the sixth the engine reports ready and every later analysis skips all of it.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The first upload pays for the engine. Every one after it is free.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: src/lib/pyodide/client.ts walks these six steps once per browser. The wording under each one is what the page actually puts on screen while you wait.

svg.text: The engine stays warm for the life of the tab. A second file skips all six steps.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Steps one to five come from cdn.jsdelivr.net, and public/sw.js caches exactly those URLs, so a returning visitor pays for none of them again.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Step six is local. It runs the four files in src/python straight out of the bundle, which is what registers the entry functions the analyses call.
